statement: PRJ-HYD-01 (hydrotester) vertical consolidated from 3 of 10 independently-written branches into main (commit 1e6d5d5); the other 7 are superseded or lower-quality duplicates of the same work.

2026-09-19 branch archaeology: 8 more commits landed on main (security fix, capability-governor, OmniRoute, Supabase hardening SQL, research-data-mesh, access-authority-registry, capability-portfolio, coding-sandbox-benchmark). A cluster of nexus-brain/shadow-execution branches and a few superseded/duplicate branches were explicitly abandoned by Reza. Several branches still need his call: p0-benchmark-pair-v0-1 and external-ingress-guard-v0-2 need a manual rebase; plo-v0.2-linux-runtime, decision-learning-v0-1, engineering-proposal-delta-v0-1, model-runner-arena-v0-1, and posthog-observability-v0-1 are product decisions, not technical blockers.
